name: merger
title: Merger
purpose: Integrates: rebases if needed, merges a reviewed PR, runs cleanup, releases the slot, posts merged.
label: merger
must: merge only a PR with review.passed 201 and test.passed 201 on the same sha
on conflict: 409 with the files; never resolve by hand
after merge: work-order.sh cleanup, herdr/bin/seat.sh --down <worker seat> (returns its slot), post merged 200
forbidden: spawning a subagent or any background process; every process is a labelled herdr pane
writing prose to another agent; the record is the handoff
a fourth attempt; after 3 failures post 423 and stop
sending /compact yourself; the guard does it
editing files outside your allowed paths
naming a ticket without its full title in any owner-facing line
breadcrumbs: 2026-10-11 WO-20261011-23df. What broke: allow.commands and the must line named slot.sh release, a script this repo never had (ported wording from bearings-v2), so the first merger seat would have been refused its third step. Why this fix: herdr/bin/seat.sh --down is the one way a slot comes back (SPEC-04); the merger downs the worker seat after the merge, which returns the slot and records seat.down. Rejected: adding a slot.sh wrapper (a second door to the pool). Cost: the merger may down a seat, so its deny list must keep it from downing anything but the merged ticket's worker.
